product.title: Cronicile Dragonilor. Zbor spre Ostrovul Dragonilor. Cartea a doua
product.description: – Frați și surori, le vorbi Quenelda, cu o forță care făcea ca până și o șoaptă a ei să ajungă la cea mai îndepărtată ureche, întunericul Abisului răsare astăzi. Curând, va sosi timpul să mă lepăd de piele și să-mi desfac aripile. Când acel moment va veni, am să vă chem să-mi fiți alături încă o dată... Războiul cumplit pe care locuitorii din Împărăţiile Celor Șapte Mări îl poartă de sute de ani cu goblinii se dezlănțuie din nou, iar Quenelda dorește să-și însoțească tatăl în luptă. Când trădarea Marelui Maestru face ravagii în rândurile armatei, iar comandantul Gărzii Dragonilor dispare pe câmpul de luptă și este considerat mort, domnița Quenelda descoperă un secret magic în inima legendarei fortărețe din Ostrovul Dragonilor. Oare își va putea folosi noile puteri pentru a salva Cele Șapte Împărății ale Mării de vrăjmășia goblinilor?

# The Chronicles of the Dragons: Flight to Dragon Island â Book Two

Dive into the epic world of high fantasy with *The Chronicles of the Dragons: Flight to Dragon Island, Book Two*, published by Litera. This installment continues the thrilling saga of Quenelda and her quest, deepening the conflicts, revealing ancient secrets, and escalating the stakes as she fights for the fate of the Seven Seas against encroaching darkness. If you are a fan of dragon lore, magical warfare, and journeys into uncharted territories, this book is an essential addition to your fantasy library.

## An Epic Journey of Power and Betrayal

The story follows Quenelda, a character imbued with extraordinary strength, whose whispers can reach the furthest ears. As the shadows of the Abyss rise, the time for change is upon her. The narrative plunges into a perilous era where the war waged by goblins against the inhabitants of the Seven Seas has lasted for centuries, fueled by deceit and ambition. This second book picks up the action as Quenelda seeks to accompany her father in the fight, facing immense internal and external pressures that threaten the balance of the world.

## Unveiling the Secret of Dragon Island

As the betrayal of the Great Master wreaks havoc among the armies, and the commander of the Dragon Guard vanishes into battle, Princess Quenelda discovers a profound magical secret hidden within the heart of the legendary fortress on Dragon Island. This discovery shifts her destiny entirely. She must now harness these newfound powers not just for personal survival, but to protect the entire Seven Kingdoms of the Sea from the devastating sorcery wielded by the goblins. This chapter explores themes of leadership, hidden magic, and the heavy burden of responsibility placed upon a young heroine.

## Why Readers Love This Fantasy Adventure

*The Chronicles of the Dragons* offers rich world-building and compelling character development, making it a must-read for fantasy enthusiasts. The narrative masterfully blends action, mystery, and deep mythological elements, inviting readers to explore complex themes of loyalty, destiny, and the struggle between light and shadow. Each page promises high-stakes adventure as Quenelda grapples with immense magical power and the need to unite fractured kingdoms against overwhelming evil. It is an immersive experience for anyone seeking classic, yet thrilling, epic storytelling.

## Product Details

Experience this captivating tale today. *The Chronicles of the Dragons: Flight to Dragon Island, Book Two* is available now from Litera.

**Price:** 34.99

**Find your copy here:** [https://www.litera.ro/cronicile-dragonilor-zbor-spre-ostrovul-dragonilor-cartea-a-doua](https://www.litera.ro/cronicile-dragonilor-zbor-spre-ostrovul-dragonilor-cartea-a-doua)

## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

**Q: What is the main focus of this book?**
A: This book focuses on Quenelda's quest to discover and utilize ancient magic hidden on Dragon Island to save the Seven Kingdoms of the Sea from goblin sorcery.

**Q: Who is the main character in this story?**
A: The story centers around Quenelda, who possesses great strength and must navigate a perilous war for her people.

**Q: What is the genre of this book?**
A: This book falls squarely within the epic fantasy genre, featuring dragons, ancient kingdoms, and magical conflict.
